title: Sher Aur Chuha Ki Kahani
description: Sher aur chuha ki ek interesting Hindi moral story jo hume dosti, daya aur madad ki seekh deti hai.
moral: Kisi ko chhota samajhkar uski madad ko kam nahi samajhna chahiye.
content: Ek baar ek ghane jungle mein ek sher rehta tha. Ek din sher ek ped ke neeche aaram kar raha tha.
Tabhi ek chhota chuha khelte-khelte sher ke upar chadh gaya. Sher ki neend khul gayi aur woh gusse mein aa gaya.
Sher chuhe ko pakadne wala tha, tab chuhe ne maafi maangi aur kaha ki shayad ek din woh bhi sher ke kaam aa sakega.
Sher ko chuhe ki baat sunkar hasi aayi, lekin usne chuhe ko chhod diya.
Kuch din baad sher ek shikari ke jaal mein phans gaya. Sher bahut koshish karne ke baad bhi jaal se bahar nahi nikal saka.
Chuha wahan se guzar raha tha. Usne sher ki awaaz suni aur turant uski madad karne aa gaya.
Chuha apne tez daanton se jaal ko kaatne laga. Thodi der mein jaal toot gaya aur sher azaad ho gaya.
Sher ko samajh aa gaya ki chhota hone ka matlab kamzor hona nahi hota.

title: Lomdi Aur Angoor Ki Kahani
description: Lomdi aur angoor ki famous Hindi moral story jo hume bahane banane ke bajay sach ko accept karna sikhati hai.
moral: Jo cheez hasil na ho sake, uske liye bahane nahi banane chahiye.
content: Ek din ek bhookhi lomdi jungle mein khana dhoondh rahi thi.
Bahut der tak ghoomne ke baad uski nazar ek bel par lage hue meethe angooron par padi.
Angoor bahut sundar aur rasbhare dikh rahe the. Lomdi unhe khana chahti thi.
Lomdi ne angooron tak pahunchne ke liye kai baar uchhalne ki koshish ki.
Lekin angoor bahut upar the aur lomdi un tak nahi pahunch paayi.
Kai baar koshish karne ke baad lomdi thak gayi.
Aakhir mein lomdi wahan se jaate hue boli ki angoor shayad khatte hi honge.
Lekin sach ye tha ki lomdi un angooron tak pahunch nahi paayi thi.

title: Kauwa Aur Lomdi Ki Kahani
description: Kauwa aur lomdi ki interesting Hindi moral story jo hume jhoothi tareef se bachne ki seekh deti hai.
moral: Jhoothi tareef par jaldi vishwas nahi karna chahiye.
content: Ek din ek kauwa ek ped ki daali par roti ka tukda lekar baitha tha.
Ek chalak lomdi ki nazar kauwe aur uski roti par pad gayi.
Lomdi roti paana chahti thi, isliye usne kauwe ki tareef karni shuru kar di.
Lomdi ne kaha ki kauwa bahut sundar dikhta hai aur shayad uski awaaz bhi bahut pyari hogi.
Kauwa lomdi ki tareef sunkar khush ho gaya.
Lomdi ne kaha ki agar kauwa ek gaana gaaye to woh uski awaaz sun sakti hai.
Jaise hi kauwe ne gaane ke liye apna muh khola, roti neeche gir gayi.
Lomdi ne turant roti uthayi aur wahan se bhaag gayi.
Kauwe ko samajh aa gaya ki lomdi ne jhoothi tareef karke use bewakoof banaya tha.

title: Pyaasa Kauwa Ki Kahani
description: Pyaasa kauwa ki Hindi moral story jo bachchon ko samasya ka hal dhoondhne aur himmat na haarne ki seekh deti hai.
moral: Buddhi aur mehnat se mushkil samasya ka hal nikala ja sakta hai.
content: Ek bahut garm din ek kauwa bahut pyasa tha.
Kauwa paani ki talaash mein idhar-udhar udta raha.
Kuch der baad use ek matka dikhai diya.
Kauwa matke ke paas gaya aur usne dekha ki matke mein thoda sa paani tha.
Kauwe ki chonch paani tak nahi pahunch rahi thi.
Kauwe ne aas-paas pade chhote patthar dekhe.
Usne ek-ek karke patthar matke mein daalne shuru kiye.
Patthar daalne se paani dheere-dheere upar aa gaya.
Kauwe ne paani piya aur apni pyas bujha li.

title: Khargosh Aur Kachhua Ki Kahani
description: Khargosh aur kachhua ki famous Hindi moral story jo hume patience aur lagatar mehnat ki seekh deti hai.
moral: Dheere chalne wala bhi lagatar mehnat se jeet sakta hai.
content: Ek jungle mein ek khargosh aur ek kachhua rehte the.
Khargosh apni tez daud par bahut ghamand karta tha.
Ek din khargosh ne kachhua ka mazaak udaya.
Kachhua ne khargosh ko race ki chunauti de di.
Race shuru hui aur khargosh bahut tez bhaag kar aage nikal gaya.
Khargosh ne socha ki kachhua bahut peeche hai, isliye woh ped ke neeche aaram karne laga.
Kachhua dheere-dheere bina ruke aage badhta raha.
Khargosh so gaya aur kachhua finish line tak pahunch gaya.
Jab khargosh ki aankh khuli to kachhua race jeet chuka tha.

title: Do Bakriyon Ki Kahani
description: Do bakriyon ki Hindi moral story jo hume gusse ke bajay samajhdari se kaam lene ki seekh deti hai.
moral: Jid aur gusse se nuksan ho sakta hai, isliye samajhdari se kaam lena chahiye.
content: Ek baar do bakriyan ek chhote pul par aamne-saamne aa gayin.
Pul itna chhota tha ki dono ek saath usse paar nahi kar sakti thi.
Dono bakriyan ek doosre ko raasta dene ke liye taiyar nahi thi.
Dono gusse mein ek doosre ko dhakka dene lagi.
Aakhir mein dono ka santulan bigad gaya aur dono neeche gir gayin.
Agar dono mein se ek bakri thoda intezar kar leti to dono aasani se pul paar kar sakti thi.
Is kahani se hume samajh aata hai ki gusse aur zid se aksar nuksan hota hai.
